title: Implement Buyer Workflow Logic
goal: Implement the core logic for the Buyer Journey: Intake -> Qualification -> Matching.

sub_tasks.output: Define state machine for Buyer Qualification (Budget -> Location -> Type).

decisions: Use a simple state machine for qualification flow.
Store partial state in Redis until qualification is complete.
acceptance_criteria: Bot asks for Budget, Location, and Type sequentially.
Contact status updates to 'Warm' upon completion.
result_summary: Buyer Workflow initialized with state machine and qualification scripts.
